config.model.description: large-v3 prioritizes multilingual quality. turbo and smaller models reduce time and memory use.
config.device.description: auto tries NVIDIA CUDA and falls back to CPU when unavailable. Apple/AMD use CPU.
config.language.description: auto selects only Spanish or English for each segment. es or en fixes a single language.
config.initialPrompt.description: Optional vocabulary or proper names to guide recognition.
config.offline.description: Use downloaded models only; block engine downloads during transcription.
config.pythonPath.description: Optional Python executable for creating the private environment. Python 3.12 is recommended. The system Python is not modified.
config.diarization.description: Detect speakers locally and assign a voice ID to each utterance. Names can be edited per video.
config.numSpeakers.description: Known number of speakers; 0 estimates it automatically. Useful when automatic detection merges or splits voices.
config.speakerThreshold.description: Automatic voice clustering threshold. A lower value tends to detect more speakers. Only used when numSpeakers = 0.
config.groupDialogues.description: Group consecutive segments in Reading by speaker and pauses. Timing preserves the original segments.
config.dialogueGapSeconds.description: Maximum pause in seconds between segments joined into one dialogue. Without speaker assignments, grouping uses timing only.
config.dialogueMaxSeconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds when joining segments into a reading block.
config.interfaceLanguage.description: Extension interface language. Does not change the transcription language or saved data.
